deals.title: Happy Hour
deals.summary: Specialty bites, sandwiches, snacks, plus discounts on beer, wine, cocktails and boozy slushees
deals.evidence: Our East Dallas happy hour is from 2pm to 6pm Monday through Friday and features a unique menu of specialty bites, sandwiches, snacks, and discounts on beer, wine, cocktails and our signature boozy slushess.

notes: Detailed happy hour prices appear only on Houston menus; not applied to the Dallas East location. 'Loro Step $15 (All Day, Every Day)' is a regular menu item, not included as a deal.
